text:
**Monday**, an ordinary school day with ASL Club after it, 3:45 to 4:30. Tonight is one of your two evenings this week without Tae Kwon Do, so it is the easy one to use.

Biology has moved on to DNA, and your Biology shelf has a DNA lesson for it. The base pairs are the part worth locking in early: A with T, C with G. Make those automatic tonight and the rest of the unit has something to stand on.
